title: Satori customer extension library
description: Scaffolds a Layer 2 extension library: a provider that contributes slots, rules, actions and components to the platform by ID, with a spec that proves the registration actually happened.

name.description: Library name, kebab-case. Becomes the directory and the Nx project name.

owner.description: Owner prefix for every registered ID, as in <owner>.<surface>.<name>. Renaming it later is a breaking change for any manifest referencing these IDs.
owner.x-prompt: Owner prefix for extension IDs (e.g. acme)?

force.description: Overwrite the generated files if the library already exists. For the loop of editing a template and regenerating.
